answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 10576 Country: India Title: When I am going out, I always making WUZU. One day I went out side with WUZU. When I returned, ASR Azan started, I thought I have WUZU pray salah then go to home. Now salah started and I was in the middle of the first saf(line). After one rakat is over, then I remember I had passed Urine at an office. That time I have completed salah because there was no way to go back from any side. after finishing salah I went home, changed my clothes made WUZU and repeated ASR salah. Is it OK? If not, then what should I do at that situation. Question: When I am going out, I always making WUZU. One day I went out side with WUZU. When I returned, ASR Azan started, I thought I have WUZU pray salah then go to home. Now salah started and I was in the middle of the first saf(line). After one rakat is over, then I remember I had passed Urine at an office. That time I have completed salah because there was no way to go back from any side. after finishing salah I went home, changed my clothes made WUZU and repeated ASR salah. Is it OK? If not, then what should I do at that situation. Answer ID: 10576 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 254/229=D/1430) When you were sure that you were without wudhu then you should cancel the salah. If it was difficult to go out from first row, then you should have immitated the imam in ruku and sajdah without reciting the tasbeeh . However, you should repent to Allah that you continued the salah due to ignorance. You were right to make fresh wudhu and perform salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
